observations: Red manual pallet truck partially wrapped in cardboard.
Cardboard packaging displays 'Rated lifting: 3000 KG', 'The goods fork length: 1200 MM', and 'Pallet fork width: 685 MM'.
Hydraulic pump assembly and handle base are visible.
No manufacturer name or model number is visible on the chassis or the packaging.
Watermark 'ZICO TOOLS VENTURES' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: Text on cardboard in photo 0 is a claim; the manufacturer's metal data plate is missing.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may leak or fail to hold pressure under load.
risks.proof: A video showing the truck lifting and holding a load of at least 2000kg for several minutes.

risks.risk: Structural damage or rust may be hidden under the cardboard wrapping.
risks.proof: Photos of the entire frame and forks with all cardboard removed.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used with cosmetic/structural defects

risks.risk: Wheels (load rollers and steer wheels) may be worn, cracked, or seized.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all wheels and a video of the truck being moved.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full set of replacement wheels

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's metal identification plate on the chassis.
Photos of the pallet truck with all cardboard packaging removed.
Video of the hydraulic system lifting a heavy load.
Clear photos of the wheels and rollers.
response.reason: The item is clearly a manual pallet truck. Although the brand and exact condition are unverified due to the packaging and lack of a data plate, it can be priced as a generic unbranded unit at its worst-case functional state.
